metadata.unit_note: teragrams of CH4 per year, already integrated over the cell area — not a flux density
metadata.cell_selection: every native grid cell whose rectangle intersects the country polygon
metadata.overlap_warning: border cells belong to every country they intersect, so these files overlap at borders and must not be summed for global totals

grid.note: native model grid; polar rows are clipped to +/-90

source.estimate: central inversion result — ensemble member lognormal_2.0

metadata.property_naming: emissions_<Sector>_<post|prior>; `emissions` duplicates emissions_Total_post for backward compatibility

aggregates.Total: TotalAnth + Natural + Wetlands — excludes Soil; equals the source's *_excl_soil_tg

notes: Lakes is present but identically zero everywhere in this dataset.
Soil is a negative sink, is not optimized by the inversion (prior == posterior), and is excluded from every aggregate.
